future_check: Escalate only if selected exact sync fails, archival role metadata disappears, or execution parity produces a concrete counterexample.
rationale: Textual divergence alone is not a defect when role metadata distinguishes the selected rule from preserved executable history and both programs agree on canonical and generated probes. A Racket patch would erase provenance without changing semantics.
summary: Do not patch the Racket authority: selected target_code is synchronized and the divergent raw_code is explicitly archival with execution parity.

future_check: Run the current exact override checker with 30 seeds and strict unknown-key rejection after any AXES or generation-path change; the recorded case matrix must remain complete.
rationale: The original seven-axis interface contained aliases, ignored values, degenerate paths that bypassed dimensions, and an accepted unknown key. Keeping only dimensions and realized object counts makes provenance recoverable from the returned input and prevents metadata-only controls.
summary: Expose only four exact returned-grid axes and remove pseudo-texture controls.

future_check: Require at least one shared-color opposite-fate witness in every teaching window and verify the executable global-border-color rival disagrees on held-out probes.
rationale: That rule fits all canonical examples because canonical colors are component-unique. The shared-color slot deliberately gives disconnected border and interior components the same color and opposite fates, proving the predicate is object-local.
summary: Reject the hypothesis that every component of a color seen on the border should be kept.

future_check: Re-run the 2/3/4-demo sliding-window census whenever schedule residues, witness predicates, or competitor definitions change; retain 144/144 identifiable four-demo windows in all bands.
rationale: The canonical examples are all 7x7 with object-unique colors and sparse border objects, so a purely random scene family can remain globally ambiguous. Two canonical-profile anchors plus two adversarial control slots give every four-consecutive-demo lesson a stable teaching grammar.
summary: Use a four-slot schedule that teaches component-local border contact rather than color, side, corner, count, or size shortcuts.

future_check: Re-run exact lineage matching when solved-source corpora or the official lineage registry change; retire or merge this generator if a supplied source and 2-4 verified families cover the same invariant and shortcut controls.
rationale: A bounded exact scan covered all 1,000 supplied solved training tasks and 120 supplied solved evaluation tasks for fixed-zero, modal-background, and inverse variants. Four 12-hex bank generators share the normalized rule, but none is a verified supplied source.
summary: No verified supplied 8-hex ARC source implements this exact rule; preserve an unmapped lineage instead of guessing.

future_check: When adding structural constraints, test all canonical pairs first and maintain at least four task-specific destructive mutations that are rejected without requiring every individual grid to carry every shortcut witness.
rationale: Canonical inputs include singleton objects and do not themselves refute every shortcut. A self-check that demanded every curriculum witness would reject lawful canonical scenes; structural validation instead enforces the scene grammar while four-slot lesson checks enforce teaching sufficiency.
summary: Keep self_check structural and put shortcut identifiability in semantic witnesses and lesson_identifiable.
